public_rationale: In a post on 2025-12-08, Zitron gave his own estimate of about $61 billion in total generative AI revenue, including hyperscalers and neoclouds. He named no period. He did not say whether he meant realized revenue or run rate. To check the estimate, the contract needs a credible industry-wide total for a comparable period and basis. The evidence packet does not contain one. It has two figures for single companies. Reuters, citing The Information, reported on 2025-09-30 that OpenAI earned about $4.3 billion in revenue in the first half of 2025 and was targeting $13 billion for the full year (e1). Fortune reported on 2025-01-30 that Microsoft's AI business had passed an annual revenue run rate of $13 billion (e2). That is a run rate from late 2024, not realized revenue for 2025. The two figures use different bases and periods, and together they are not an industry total. They neither confirm nor contradict the $61 billion estimate.
limitations: The packet has no industry-wide total of generative AI revenue for any period.
The packet has no figures for Alphabet, Amazon, neoclouds or AI labs other than OpenAI.
The OpenAI figure is a press report based on The Information, and Reuters said it could not immediately verify it.
The Microsoft figure is an annualized run rate as of late 2024, not realized revenue for 2025.
The packet does not show how much the lab and cloud figures overlap.
The result depends on choices of period, basis and definition that the speaker did not specify.

our_interpretation: Plain reading: the speaker gives his own estimate that all generative AI revenue earned across the industry, including hyperscalers and neoclouds and presumably model companies, adds up to about $61 billion.
He gives no period. The closest reading is recent annual revenue as of the post, so roughly calendar 2025 up to the post date. That choice is flagged.
He does not say whether this means realized revenue or annualized run rate. The claim can only be checked against a credible industry-wide total on a stated basis, and none exists.
criteria.support_condition: A credible, sourced industry-wide total of generative AI revenue for the period around the post, covering hyperscalers, neoclouds and model companies, that comes to roughly $61 billion (within about 25%).
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible industry-wide total for the same period and basis that is far from $61 billion (for example, under about $45 billion or over about $80 billion).
